हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description:
The heart-touching story of Anika, a 9-year-old orphan with dreams bigger than her circumstances. Determined to complete her education, she searches for support—but the world turns its back on her.
One fateful day, Anika crosses paths with a wealthy man when she suddenly appears in front of his car. Moved by her struggles, he becomes her benefactor and helps her continue her studies. Wanting to give her a permanent home, he asks his younger brother to adopt her. Will Anika’s faith be rewarded?
